issue_request: FHIR-13323 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core STU3 change request asking HL7 to adopt a standard URL convention for extensions used to backport newer-version elements into older-version resources, prompted by examples such as representing STU3 MedicationStatement.category in DSTU2 resources.
initial_application: The Jira records Grahame's application as svn revisions 14138-9. Git-svn commits 641002468f296d9085044e7704733e224a609f82 and 29cb644ee885b2c6959f2ab41d4b767391158b21 are labelled GF#13323 and added the source/versions.html Extensions for converting between versions section plus links from diff/transform pages.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread records the original proposed URL, Grahame's refinement to StructureDefinition/extension-[path], the later major.minor version choice, and build.fhir.org/versions.html#extensions as the applied documentation location. The later Published follow-up FHIR-16015 is already represented on the combined branch by commit a89f8026d38666b594784393f1018e403e841c08. Current source/versions.html is active via source/hierarchy.xml and later source history, including FHIR-42923, refined the URL placeholder to [defining_version] without reversing the convention.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active Change Management and Versioning page already defines http://hl7.org/fhir/[defining_version]/StructureDefinition/extension-[Path], lists formal milestone version values, gives representative extension URLs, and links to the cross-version definition package matrix.

related_jiras.note: Later Published follow-up requested documentation and generated information for the same backport extension convention and is already audited on the combined branch.
Later source history clarified the meaning of the version component in cross-version extension URLs as [defining_version].
